trends.name: Short-form video product demos
trends.description: Brands using 15-30 second product demos with trending sounds see 3x higher engagement than traditional ads

trends.name: Reddit AMA marketing
trends.description: Founder AMAs in niche subreddits generating authentic brand awareness

examples: My workflow before vs after using [product]

opportunities.suggestedAngle: Day-in-the-life format showing the team building features users requested
Weekly tips post in r/productivity with genuine value-first approach

risks.description: Short-form video trend may saturate within 3 weeks as major brands increase output
risks.mitigation: Differentiate with authentic, unpolished style rather than high-production approach

risks.description: Reddit community may reject overtly promotional content
risks.mitigation: Lead with value, disclose brand affiliation, engage genuinely in comments

recommendations: 1. Prioritize TikTok short-form video content using the hook-in-first-3-seconds pattern. 2. Establish authentic Reddit presence through value-first posts in r/productivity. 3. Cross-post successful TikTok content to Instagram Reels with platform-native adaptations.
